cross_validation.method: Independent manual parse of routes/web.php, routes/common/*.php, routes/api.php, routes/channels.php, routes/console.php, app/Admin/routes.php compared with the artisan dump; then PHP reflection over every route action to obtain declaring file + start line (ReflectionMethod).
discrepancies: routes/web.php:17-23 only globs routes/common/*.php; routes/api.php, routes/channels.php and routes/console.php are NOT required from there. api.php is loaded separately by app/Providers/RouteServiceProvider.php:73-79 (prefix api, middleware api).
channels.php and console.php register no HTTP routes (Broadcast::channel + Artisan::command only), which is why they do not appear in route:list.

All 139 production routes originate from 43 project route statements: 13 storefront (routes/common/web.php:14-41), 29 pay (routes/common/pay.php:11-49), 1 api (routes/api.php:16) plus 95 admin routes produced by expansion: Admin::routes() (vendor/dcat/laravel-admin/src/Admin.php:573-607) registers the auth resources/login/logout/setting (34) and registerHelperRoutes() the 8 dcat-api endpoints, while app/Admin/routes.php:14-24 adds 53 routes (7 Route::resource x 7 actions = 49 plus 4 single routes). 34+8+53 = 95, matching route:list.
cross_validation.controller_method_verification: PHP ReflectionMethod resolved file+line for all 142 actions; 0 unresolved actions (all CRUD actions on App\Admin\* controllers are inherited from vendor/dcat/laravel-admin/src/Http/Controllers/AdminController.php:72,88,104,144,...).

csrf.matching_semantics: Laravel matches except entries with $request->is()/fullUrlIs(); 'pay/*/notify_url' matches pay/{gateway}/notify_url, same for return_url.
csrf.consequence: Only gateway callback/return URLs are CSRF-exempt. GET-based callbacks (pay/yipay/notify_url routes/common/pay.php:28, pay/vpay/notify_url routes/common/pay.php:32) are state changing but CSRF is not applicable to GET - their only gate is the gateway signature.

admin_guard.summary: All 95 admin-prefixed routes are gated by web -> admin (admin.auth/admin.pjax/admin.bootstrap/admin.permission/admin.session/admin.upload) -> admin.force-password.
notes: auth/logout is reachable unauthenticated (except list) - unauthenticated logout is a no-op/U-C behaviour, not a bypass.
auth/setting is in the permission except list (config/admin.php:220-225) but still requires the admin session.
admin/dcat-api/* internal endpoints (9 routes) are behind the same admin session, but they instantiate classes from request input - see RA-7.

routes.notes: Builds an auto-submitting HTML form with md5 signature (YipayController.php:11-56); output is escaped with e() for key/value but the form action is the merchant-hosted URL stored in pays.merchant_key (YipayController.php:44).

routes.csrf: not applicable (GET, and path is in the except list)
routes.notes: Required fields out_trade_no/trade_no/money/sign (YipayController.php:61-64); order and gateway looked up from DB (:65-74); gateway route must equal /pay/yipay (:75-77); trade_status allow-list (:78-82); md5 over sorted params + pays.merchant_pem compared with hash_equals (YipayController.php:94); then OrderProcessService::completedOrder(out_trade_no, money, trade_no) at YipayController.php:101 inside try/catch (:99-109). Money comes from the request but is validated downstream by completedOrder().

No signature. sleep(2) then redirect(url("detail-order-sn", order_id from $_GET)) - the redirect target is built by the framework url() helper with a route parameter, so it is not an open redirect, but it lets anyone force a 2s worker sleep per request (sleep amplification on a GET).

pay_yipay.gateway_middleware_reality: dujiaoka.pay_gate_way resolves to App\Http\Middleware\PayGateWay whose handle() only calls $next($request) (app/Http/Middleware/PayGateWay.php:17-20). The 25 pay routes therefore carry a middleware name that performs no checking; all pay trust decisions are made inside the controllers (signature checks / order+gateway lookup).

public_state_changing.effect: writes .env (HomeController.php:202), DB::unprepared install.sql (:204), updates admin_users id=1 username+bcrypt password (:206-211), writes install.lock (:216)

public_state_changing.precondition: CSRF token; captcha only if is_open_img_code=1 (default CLOSE)
public_state_changing.effect: inserts order, may decrement stock / reserve card keys (OrderController.php:57-92)

public_state_changing.precondition: valid order_sn + Stripe token; context HMAC validated only when the parameter is present
public_state_changing.effect: Stripe Charge::create against the merchant account (StripeController.php:544)

upload_endpoints.public_uploads: None. No route outside /admin accepts $_FILES. public/uploads does not exist in the repository (created at image build, Dockerfile:22-27) and nginx denies .php inside /uploads/ and /storage/ (conf/dujiaoka-nginx.conf:10-29).

admin_uploads.notes: Does NOT call $form->passesAuthorization() (compare handle() at :20-24); the form class comes from request parameter Form::REQUEST_NAME and is instantiated with app($formClass) (:94-107).
$form->image('picture')->autoUpload()->uniqueName() - the only project-defined image upload; stored under the dcat disk config.

observations: doInstall validates admin_username ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,32}$, admin_password >= 10 chars, app_url FILTER_VALIDATE_URL, admin_path ^/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ and rejects CR/LF in 13 named fields (HomeController.php:135-158).

The .env template substitution loop (HomeController.php:194-200) escapes backslash, double quote and dollar for the 13 validated fields but iterates $request->all(), so any other POST key whose name matches a {placeholder} in .env.example is substituted without the CR/LF pre-check (:138-145 only covers the listed names).
Only POST is accepted, so the install takeover requires either the CSRF token or a same-site request; both install routes disappear once install.lock exists.

other_anonymous_authz_notes.order_lookup_without_ownership: detailOrderSN() is an unscoped where(order_sn) lookup (app/Service/OrderService.php:212-216) reused by /bill/{orderSN}, /detail-order-sn/{orderSN}, /search-order-by-sn, /search-order-by-email, /search-order-by-browser. Order SNs are 16 random alphanumerics (uppercased) generated in app/Service/OrderProcessService.php:317, which is the only thing preventing enumeration.
other_anonymous_authz_notes.email_only_order_disclosure: search-order-by-email requires only email when is_open_search_pwd is CLOSE (default: app/Admin/Forms/SystemSetting.php:51-52 default STATUS_CLOSE; gate at app/Http/Controllers/Home/OrderController.php:208-216), and the rendered orderinfo page prints the delivered card secret $order["info"] (resources/views/hyper/static_pages/orderinfo.blade.php:97).
other_anonymous_authz_notes.no_throttle_on_storefront: The web middleware group has no throttle, and none of the 13 storefront routes declares throttle; the api group throttle:60,1 only applies to /api/user (app/Http/Kernel.php:34-48).
other_anonymous_authz_notes.captcha_surfaces: img_verify_code is validated by App\Rules\VerifyImg only when is_open_img_code=1 (app/Rules/VerifyImg.php:27-33). The geetest branch in OrderService::validatorCreateOrder negates a Validator object, which is always false, so geetest is never enforced (app/Service/OrderService.php:81-90).

gaps.reason: Anonymous route writes .env, imports the schema and sets the administrator credentials; only gate is the absence of install.lock plus CSRF.
Returns up to 5 orders incl. delivered card secrets for any e-mail when is_open_search_pwd is off (default); no captcha, no throttle.
Order detail incl. delivered cards rendered without any session/ownership/password check; mitigated only by 16-char random order_sn.
The HMAC context token is validated only when the request supplies it (filled()), so the state-changing charge path also succeeds without it.
gaps.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Pay/StripeController.php:536 (same pattern at :449 for return_url and :490 for check)

gaps.reason: sleep(2) executes before the redirect for any anonymous GET with order_id, allowing cheap worker-process exhaustion.

risks.title: Anonymous /do-install can rewrite .env, import the schema and set the administrator account whenever install.lock is missing
risks.evidence: routes/common/web.php:37-42 registers GET install + POST do-install inside middleware install.check; app/Http/Middleware/InstallCheck.php:17-23 only checks file_exists(base_path()/install.lock); app/Http/Controllers/Home/HomeController.php:202 file_put_contents(.env), :204 DB::unprepared(install.sql), :206-211 update admin_users id=1 with attacker-chosen username + bcrypt(password), :216 writes install.lock. install.lock is absent from the working tree (verified with ls).
risks.why_it_may_not_be_exploitable: The route set self-destructs as soon as install.lock exists, the shipped image creates the lock at container start unless INSTALL=true (Dockerfile:12-16), POST requires a CSRF token, and install.sql only succeeds against an empty database. Exploitation requires a deployment that is either freshly started without a lock or whose lock was deleted (restore/migration).
risks.recommendation: Fail closed: require an install token/APP_KEY from env, or ship install.lock in the image and delete the routes after install. Verify installed instances respond with a redirect on /install.

risks.title: dujiaoka.pay_gate_way middleware is an empty passthrough, so 25 pay routes have no middleware-level protection
risks.evidence: app/Http/Middleware/PayGateWay.php:17-20 handle() returns $next($request) unconditionally; app/Http/Kernel.php:70 aliases dujiaoka.pay_gate_way to it; routes/common/pay.php:15 applies it to all 25 pay/* routes.
risks.why_it_may_not_be_exploitable: Each controller performs its own order lookup + gateway match (PayController::loadGateWay, app/Http/Controllers/PayController.php:89-107) and the notify handlers verify gateway signatures with hash_equals, so the missing middleware is not by itself an authentication gap.
risks.recommendation: Either implement the intended checks (order/payway/gateway consistency) in the middleware or delete the alias to avoid a false sense of protection; add a regression test asserting the middleware rejects a mismatched payway.

risks.title: Geetest validation is dead code: the condition negates a Validator object, so captcha enforcement can never trigger on order creation
risks.evidence: app/Service/OrderService.php:81-90 — `dujiaoka_config_get(is_open_geetest) == STATUS_OPEN && !Validator::make($request->all(), ["geetest_challenge" => "geetest"], ...)`; a Validator instance is always truthy so `!` is always false and the RuleValidationException on :89 is unreachable. Additionally no "geetest" validation rule is registered anywhere in app/ or config/.
risks.why_it_may_not_be_exploitable: The image captcha (img_verify_code -> App\Rules\VerifyImg, app/Rules/VerifyImg.php:27-33) can still gate order creation, and the geetest switch defaults to CLOSE (app/Http/Middleware/DujiaoBoot.php:41-42, app/Admin/Forms/SystemSetting.php:89). The impact is that an operator who enables geetest in the admin panel gets no protection while believing otherwise.
risks.recommendation: Replace with `->fails()` on the validator and register/verify a real geetest rule; add a test that enabling is_open_geetest blocks an order POST without a valid challenge.

risks.title: Order detail pages have no ownership check; the delivered card secret is rendered for anyone who can present an order number or an e-mail address
risks.evidence: app/Service/OrderService.php:212-216 detailOrderSN() = Order::query()->where(order_sn, $orderSN)->first() with no user/password scoping; app/Http/Controllers/Home/OrderController.php:171-179 (detail-order-sn) and :206-222 (search-order-by-email, where the search_pwd branch is skipped unless is_open_search_pwd=OPEN, default CLOSE at :211); resources/views/hyper/static_pages/orderinfo.blade.php:97 renders {{$order["info"]}}.
risks.why_it_may_not_be_exploitable: Order SNs are 16 random uppercase alphanumerics (app/Service/OrderProcessService.php:317) so SN-based enumeration is impractical, and the e-mail route still needs the victim e-mail address plus up to 5 results with no rate limit. Card delivery to the buyer by e-mail/URL is the intended design of the product.
risks.recommendation: Enforce search_pwd by default (or per-order), bind order detail to the dujiaoka_orders cookie/session, and add throttling + captcha to the search endpoints.

risks.title: Admin internal endpoints instantiate classes from request input and the upload variant skips form authorization
risks.evidence: POST /admin/dcat-api/form, /admin/dcat-api/form/upload, /admin/dcat-api/action, /admin/dcat-api/value, /admin/dcat-api/render all resolve to Dcat controllers; vendor/dcat/laravel-admin/src/Http/Controllers/HandleFormController.php:94-107 reads Form::REQUEST_NAME from the request and calls app($formClass); uploadFile() (:37-44) does not call $form->passesAuthorization() although handle() does (:20-24).
risks.why_it_may_not_be_exploitable: All of these paths sit behind the admin session plus admin.permission (config/admin.php:74, 214-226), so reaching them already requires an administrator account; classes must exist and implement handle()/upload semantics.
risks.recommendation: Treat as a post-auth attack surface: review the dcat fork for the class-instantiation path during the sinks phase and add passesAuthorization() to uploadFile in the pinned fork if upstream has not.

risks.title: Dev-only Ignition routes (_ignition/execute-solution, /update-config, /health-check) appear in the working-tree route table
risks.evidence: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app webdevops/php:8.3 php artisan route:list --json -> 142 routes including POST _ignition/execute-solution, POST _ignition/update-config, GET _ignition/health-check guarded only by Spatie\LaravelIgnition\Http\Middleware\RunnableSolutionsEnabled; the same command against the shipped image (no mount) returns 139 routes and 0 _ignition routes.
risks.why_it_may_not_be_exploitable: Production images install with --no-dev (Dockerfile:9, Dockerfile-ARM64:31) so the package is absent; the middleware also requires debug + local environment.
risks.recommendation: Keep APP_DEBUG=false / APP_ENV=production in every reachable deployment and add a deploy assertion that `php artisan route:list | grep _ignition` is empty.

risks.title: GET-based payment callbacks (yipay, vpay) can be triggered by any third-party page and are CSRF-exempt by construction
risks.evidence: routes/common/pay.php:28 GET pay/yipay/notify_url, routes/common/pay.php:32 GET pay/vpay/notify_url; both are also inside the CSRF except list (app/Http/Middleware/VerifyCsrfToken.php:24-25) although CSRF does not apply to GET. Handlers verify md5 signatures with the gateway secret (app/Http/Controllers/Pay/YipayController.php:85-100, app/Http/Controllers/Pay/VpayController.php:52-86).
risks.why_it_may_not_be_exploitable: Without the gateway secret an attacker cannot produce a valid signature, so the state change is not forgeable; the residual risk is that any party who learns the secret can replay a signed callback repeatedly (no nonce/replay cache was found) and that a cross-site GET can force the handler to run.
risks.recommendation: Accept POST only for callbacks, or add an idempotency/replay guard keyed on trade_no, and verify the signature covers the amount that is actually credited.

risks.title: /api/user is a dead surface: token guard against a users table the shipped schema never creates
risks.evidence: routes/api.php:16 Route::middleware(auth:api)->get(/user, ...); config/auth.php:44-48 guard api = token/provider users -> App\User; database/sql/install.sql CREATE TABLE list (8-484) contains admin_users but no users table and no api_token column.
risks.why_it_may_not_be_exploitable: The guard can never authenticate, so the closure cannot return a user; the route is effectively unreachable except as an error surface.
risks.recommendation: Remove routes/api.php or add the missing migration if the API is intended; no further auditing is needed on this route.

risks.title: No throttling on any storefront or pay route; the only rate limit is on the api group and the admin login
risks.evidence: app/Http/Kernel.php:34-48 (web group has no throttle, api group has throttle:60,1); none of the 13 storefront routes (routes/common/web.php:12-35) declares throttle; admin login has an explicit RateLimiter (app/Admin/Controllers/AuthController.php:17-26).
risks.why_it_may_not_be_exploitable: Order creation still passes CSRF + optional image captcha, and nginx/edge rate limiting may exist in deployments (not visible in conf/dujiaoka-nginx.conf).
risks.recommendation: Add throttle to create-order, the three search endpoints and pay/yipay/return_url; document required edge limits.

handoffs.reason: Unauthenticated/user-controlled entry points worth tracing: /do-install (13 named POST fields + arbitrary key->.env substitution, HomeController.php:189-202), /create-order (dynamic charge fields via format_charge_input, app/Service/OrderService.php:185-201), /search-order-by-* (raw e-mail/SN into Eloquent where clauses), /detail-order-sn (unscoped query), pay notify handlers (md5/hash_equals and completedOrder money handling), admin/dcat-api/* (app($formClass) at vendor/dcat/laravel-admin/src/Http/Controllers/HandleFormController.php:107).
auth_gap_report gaps RA-4 (order ownership) and RA-1 (install takeover) need dynamic confirmation; credentials for the admin guard would come from the deployment being tested.

CSRF except list is minimal (app/Http/Middleware/VerifyCsrfToken.php:21-26); verify same-site cookie config (config/session.php, SESSION_SAME_SITE) before concluding anything about POST /create-order and admin POSTs.

Admin prefix defaults to "admin" (config/admin.php:70), ADMIN_HTTPS handling (app/Http/Middleware/DujiaoSystem.php:17-29), TrustProxies empty by default (app/Http/Middleware/TrustProxies.php:19-35) which affects getClientIp() used in the login rate-limit key.

[Needs Verification] OrderProcessService::completedOrder() amount/trade_no validation (money mismatch, duplicate trade_no) was not traced here - it is the decisive control for every notify_url route and belongs to the sinks/verification phase.
[Needs Verification] Actual HTTP behaviour (redirect codes, 401 vs 302 on admin routes, middleware ordering under HTTPS) was not exercised: MODE=static, no web server or database was started.
